name: amazon-enterprise-platform
description: Enterprise-grade Amazon E-Commerce platform with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, compliant with DPDP Act 2023.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Full-Stack Engineer
